title: EFC v2.1 – Complete Edition
abstract: Presents the Complete Edition of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC v2.1), a unified thermodynamic framework where a continuous energy–entropy flow field Ef generates spacetime structure, cosmic dynamics, and reflexive cognition. The paper adds an Energy-Flow Ontology, explicit continuity and conservation laws, cognitive thermodynamics, an Intelligence–Matter Exchange (IMX) model, observational links with testable predictions, and a computational implementation plan.
